title: Pattern Formation in Quantum Hierarchical Cellular Neural Networks
summary: We present a new class of quantum neural networks (QNNs) whose states are solutions of $p$-adic Schrödinger equations with a non-local potential that controls the interaction between the neurons. These equations are obtained as Wick rotations of the state equations of $p$-adic cellular neural networks (CNNs). The CNNs are continuous limits of discrete hierarchical neural networks (NNs). The CNNs are bio-inspired by the Wilson-Cowan model, which describes the macroscopic dynamics of large populations of neurons.
